tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search currently published properties in Portugal by exact structured filters. Requires purpose; municipality requires district. Rental budgets require month/week/night. Up to 20 results, cursor tied to filters. No results means no listing matches these filters.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Get current public details using the public id returned by search_properties. Draft, archived, sold, removed or unknown properties return not found. No private owner/contact/CRM data.

tools.name: compare_properties
tools.description: Compare 2–4 distinct public property IDs using the same fields and explicit EUR/period/m2 units. Null is unknown. Fails if any requested property is no longer public.

tools.name: get_area_statistics
tools.description: Read INE median completed dwelling sale value per m2 for a Portuguese municipality, with period, source and license. Not asking prices, rents, a valuation or forecast. Requires both district and municipality slugs.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_properties" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search currently published properties in Portugal by exact structured filters. Requires purpose; municipality requires district. Rental budgets require month/week/night. Up to 20 results, cursor tied to filters. No results means no matches; do not widen filters without asking." → after: "Search currently published properties in Portugal by exact structured filters. Requires purpose; municipality requires district. Rental budgets require month/week/night. Up to 20 results, cursor tied to filters. No results means no listing matches these filters."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
